name: splitter
purpose: Two or more resizable panes, side by side or stacked, following the WAI-ARIA APG window splitter: each separator is a focusable role=separator with aria-valuenow, min, and max, moved by dragging or by arrow keys, Home, and End; Enter collapses and restores a collapsible pane, and a double-click resets the sizes. Min and max sizes take pixels or percentages; splitters nest. The component stores nothing: sizes are reported in aui-change for the application to persist.
whenToUse: Master-detail layouts (a list beside its detail) where users want to choose the proportions.
Tool layouts with a sidebar, an editor, and a preview or console.
Comparing two documents side by side.
whenNotToUse: Fixed page layouts: use Layout (Grid, Flex) or Sidebar.
Small screens where panes cannot be usefully side by side: stack them or use Tabs.
Showing and hiding a single region: use Collapsible or Drawer.
responsive: Pane sizes are fractions of the available space, so proportions hold when the container resizes; pixel minimums and maximums are enforced again after a resize.
rtl: Horizontal splitters mirror: the first pane is on the right, and Left Arrow grows it.
theme: Component tokens splitter-size (space-3, the separator thickness), splitter-line-color (color-border, decorative), and splitter-grip-color (color-border-strong, 3:1 against color-surface in the contrast gate). The focus ring uses the shared focus tokens; forced colors use CanvasText and ButtonText.
security: Pane content is inserted as given (the application owns it). No HTML parsing.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry; the application persists the sizes from aui-change.

budgets.budget: one custom property per pane; no layout reads besides the host size

performance.testedScale: Up to 10 panes per splitter and three levels of nesting.

limitations: A separator moves only its two neighboring panes.
The separator is 12px thick by default (splitter-size); its target spans the whole pane length.
Sizes are percentages of the space between separators; pixel sizes in panes[].size apply to the first layout only.
unsupported: Storing sizes (localStorage or cookies) inside the component: persist aui-change sizes in the application.
antiPatterns: Nesting splitters more than two or three levels deep.
Panes without minimum sizes that can be squeezed to an unusable width.
